signals_info.description: One-sample Boolean event indicating that parking has completed.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the parking completion event shall equal 1.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，泊车完成事件应为 1。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The parking maneuver shall be recorded as complete now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 泊车操作应在当前或之后某个时刻被记录为完成。
